lines.zh: 摆一下尾，我贴着沙底往前游。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I glide along the sand.

lines.zh: 海草擦过鳞片，像有人挠我。
lines.en: Kelp brushes my scales like a finger scratching.

lines.zh: 紫色的鳞在水里晃出淡光。
lines.en: My purple scales throw a faint light underwater.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，怕撞上石缝。
lines.en: I swim slowly, afraid of the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 上面有光斑，我朝那道光游。
lines.en: There is a bright patch above; I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 两格深的水，就够我过一天。
lines.en: Two blocks of water are enough for my whole day.

lines.zh: 我绕开那条比我大的鱼。
lines.en: I steer around that fish bigger than me.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，水纹荡到岸边。
lines.en: One tail flick sends ripples to the bank.

lines.zh: 水里每条缝我都游过一遍。
lines.en: I have swum through every crack down here.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草根，慢慢挪位置。
lines.en: I hug the kelp roots and shift along slowly.

lines.zh: 前面水面太亮，我往下潜。
lines.en: The surface is too bright ahead; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼很小，游得却快。
lines.en: I am a small fish, but quick through the water.

lines.zh: 鳞片碰着石头，发出轻响。
lines.en: My scales click lightly against the stone.

lines.zh: 我往深处游，那里没人看我。
lines.en: I head deeper, where nobody watches me.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块紫石头转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a purple stone twice.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑到水草边，吹了个泡。
lines.en: I nudge up to the weeds and blow a bubble.

lines.zh: 我停在水草里，一动不动。
lines.en: I rest inside the weeds without moving.

lines.zh: 鳃一张一合，水从旁边过。
lines.en: My gills open and close as water slips past.

lines.zh: 紫色鳞片是我唯一的伪装。
lines.en: Purple scales are the only disguise I own.

lines.zh: 两点血的生命，经不起一下。
lines.en: Two hearts of life will not survive one blow.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步声。
lines.en: I hear footsteps up on the bank.

lines.zh: 水底很静，只有气泡在响。
lines.en: The bottom is quiet; only bubbles make sound.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进石缝的阴影。
lines.en: I wedge myself into the shadow of a crevice.

lines.zh: 有人在钓鱼，我不咬钩。
lines.en: Someone is fishing; I will not take the hook.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比脑袋更常动。
lines.en: My tail moves far more often than my head.

lines.zh: 在这里待久了，石头都认得我。
lines.en: I have stayed so long the stones know me.

lines.zh: 水面晃，我的影子也晃。
lines.en: The surface sways, and my shadow sways with it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，鱼没有多余的嗓子。
lines.en: I make no sound; fish have no spare voice.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来就住在这条沟。
lines.en: I have lived in this trench since the egg.

lines.zh: 等天黑，我再游去浅处。
lines.en: I will swim to the shallows once it is dark.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲着，我看得见。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank; I can see you.

lines.zh: 你的影子把水面压暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow presses the water dark.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进来，我往后退。
lines.en: Your hand reaches in, and I back away.

lines.zh: 你也在水里，可你太响了。
lines.en: You are in the water too, but far too loud.

lines.zh: 你木桶里的水晃得我眼晕。
lines.en: The water sloshing in your bucket makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩得水底发浑。
lines.en: Your boots stir the bottom into mud.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我认得网。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I know nets.

lines.zh: 你把脸凑近，我钻进草里。
lines.en: You lean your face close; I dive into the weeds.

lines.zh: 你看着我，像在看一条鱼。
lines.en: You look at me the way one looks at a fish.

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我鳞片很滑。
lines.en: Do not grab with your hand; my scales are slick.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我立刻掉头。
lines.en: One blow, and I turn tail at once.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片掉了一片在水里。
lines.en: A scale of mine drifts down through the water.

lines.zh: 鳞片下发烫，我直往下沉。
lines.en: My scales burn hot, and I sink straight down.

lines.zh: 谁打的我？水都红了。
lines.en: Who struck me? The water has gone red.

lines.zh: 我只有两点心，别再来一下。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; no second hit.

lines.zh: 我乱摆尾，撞了石头。
lines.en: I thrash and knock into the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打出了草堆。
lines.en: That knocked me clear of the weeds.

lines.zh: 我喘不上水，鳃在抖。
lines.en: I cannot draw water; my gills are trembling.

lines.zh: 尾巴不听使唤，我打了个转。
lines.en: My tail will not obey; I spin in a circle.

lines.zh: 逃，先逃，别的以后想。
lines.en: Flee first; think about the rest later.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎食，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the crushed food you scattered.

lines.zh: 那点浮饵，我绕着看三圈。
lines.en: I circle that floating bait three times.

lines.zh: 我饿了，可钩子我不敢碰。
lines.en: I am hungry, but the hook I dare not touch.

lines.zh: 香味从你掌心飘下来。
lines.en: The smell drifts down from your palm.

lines.zh: 我先咬一小口，再游开。
lines.en: I take one small bite, then swim off.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西沉到沙里了。
lines.en: What you dropped has sunk into the sand.

lines.zh: 我靠近，又退回去。
lines.en: I come near, then retreat again.

lines.zh: 食物边上总有影子在动。
lines.en: Something always moves beside the food.

lines.zh: 我张一下嘴，只是试试。
lines.en: I open my mouth once, only testing.

lines.zh: 你别动，我才敢吃。
lines.en: Stay still, and only then will I dare eat.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，水撞得我打转。
lines.en: You bump into me and the water spins me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片被你刮掉一片。
lines.en: One of my scales has been scraped off.

lines.zh: 退开点，水都被你挤走。
lines.en: Move back; you push all the water away.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，赶紧摆正。
lines.en: I flip over and hurriedly right myself.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰上了我的侧身。
lines.en: Your knee knocked against my flank.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁，让你先过。
lines.en: I press to the wall and let you pass.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推出去一格。
lines.en: That shoved me a whole block away.

lines.zh: 水花这么大，鱼都吓跑了。
lines.en: Such a splash; the fish have all fled.

lines.zh: 轻轻碰一下，我也受不了。
lines.en: Even a light nudge is too much for me.

lines.zh: 你两腿之间有条缝，我钻。
lines.en: There is a gap between your legs; I slip through.

lines.zh: 同类甩尾，我就跟上去。
lines.en: A kin flicks its tail, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏在草根下面。
lines.en: We hide the eggs beneath the weed roots.

lines.zh: 水里浮起一串细泡，是它。
lines.en: A string of tiny bubbles rises; that is them.

lines.zh: 两条紫影绕成一个圈。
lines.en: Two purple shapes circle into a ring.

lines.zh: 我们不碰鳍，只靠得近。
lines.en: We do not touch fins, only come near.

lines.zh: 卵很多，能长大的没几条。
lines.en: Many eggs, and few will ever grow.

lines.zh: 它游走了，我还留在原地。
lines.en: They swim off; I stay where I am.

lines.zh: 水草被我们拨得乱晃。
lines.en: The weeds sway wildly where we passed.

lines.zh: 这条沟里，紫色的只剩我们。
lines.en: In this trench, only we are purple.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，会多一群小鱼。
lines.en: By this time next year, a school will be here.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着一块铁片。
lines.en: I hold a scrap of iron in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你掉的线头，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up the thread you dropped.

lines.zh: 这东西亮，我以为是鳞片。
lines.en: This thing gleams; I mistook it for a scale.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，游得很别扭。
lines.en: Carrying it makes my swimming awkward.

lines.zh: 水底的东西，谁掉的就归谁？
lines.en: Whatever sinks — does it belong to whoever dropped it?

lines.zh: 我把它塞进石缝里收好。
lines.en: I tuck it into a crevice for safekeeping.

lines.zh: 太重了，我松了口。
lines.en: It was too heavy; I let go.

lines.zh: 这块石头有股铁腥味。
lines.en: This stone smells of iron.

lines.zh: 我叼过来，又不知给谁。
lines.en: I bring it over, unsure who to give it to.

lines.zh: 我的收藏都在那块礁石下。
lines.en: My collection is all under that reef.

lines.zh: 水纹一变，我就知道要跑。
lines.en: When the ripples change, I know to flee.

lines.zh: 那道影子落下来，我锁住出口。
lines.en: That shadow falls; I fix on the exit.

lines.zh: 我认准石缝，尾巴先转。
lines.en: I pick the crevice and turn my tail first.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我盯住它。
lines.en: Something is coming; I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 逃跑的路只有一条，我记着。
lines.en: There is one escape route, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 网下来的方向，我算好了。
lines.en: I have worked out where the net will fall.

lines.zh: 我不打，我只找缝钻。
lines.en: I do not fight; I look for a gap.

lines.zh: 危险来了，我先缩进阴影。
lines.en: Danger comes; I shrink into the shadow first.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼在转，我等着。
lines.en: That big fish is circling; I wait.

lines.zh: 我盯住水面，等它破开。
lines.en: I watch the surface, waiting for it to break.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，不敢靠近。
lines.en: I circle it, not daring to come close.

lines.zh: 它的鳞比我的硬多了。
lines.en: Its scales are far harder than mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根晃动的线。
lines.en: I stare at that swaying line.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就退半格。
lines.en: It moves, and I back off half a block.

lines.zh: 我伏进一层薄沙里。
lines.en: I sink beneath a thin layer of sand.

lines.zh: 它没看我，可我知道它在。
lines.en: It does not look at me, but I know it is there.

lines.zh: 我数它的鳍，数到第三下。
lines.en: I count its fins, up to the third beat.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变重了。
lines.en: The taste of the water has grown heavy.

lines.zh: 我准备好随时掉头。
lines.en: I am ready to turn and run at any moment.

lines.zh: 这么近，我只能屏住鳃。
lines.en: This close, I can only hold my gills still.

lines.zh: 被逼到石缝，我也咬一口。
lines.en: Cornered in the crevice, I bite once.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，只能留个印。
lines.en: My teeth are small; I can only leave a mark.

lines.zh: 我甩尾打水，想把你赶开。
lines.en: I slap the water with my tail to drive you off.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我只会乱撞。
lines.en: Do not corner me; I can only thrash.

lines.zh: 这一口是我最后的办法。
lines.en: This bite is my last resort.

lines.zh: 我撞在你手上，滑开了。
lines.en: I strike your hand and slide off.

lines.zh: 在水里，你转身比我慢。
lines.en: Underwater, you turn more slowly than I do.

lines.zh: 我咬住线，不是咬你。
lines.en: I bit the line, not you.

lines.zh: 紫鳞竖起，是警告的样子。
lines.en: My purple scales bristle as a warning.

lines.zh: 咬完这一口，我钻进石缝。
lines.en: After this one bite, I duck into the rocks.

lines.zh: 我在水底睁开眼，四周是沙。
lines.en: I open my eyes on the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 这条沟的水很凉，正合适。
lines.en: The water in this trench is cold and right.

lines.zh: 我一出生就会摆尾。
lines.en: I could flick my tail from the moment I hatched.

lines.zh: 上方有光，我先躲进草里。
lines.en: Light above; I hide in the weeds first.

lines.zh: 卵壳裂在石缝里，我游出去。
lines.en: My eggshell split in the crevice; I swam out.

lines.zh: 我把第一口水咽下去。
lines.en: I swallow my first mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 水面很远，我慢慢浮上去。
lines.en: The surface is far; I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这条沟有七条鱼。
lines.en: I count seven fish in this trench.

lines.zh: 紫色的鳞还没长硬。
lines.en: My purple scales have not hardened yet.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这条沟归我游。
lines.en: From today, this trench is mine to swim.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的鳞片卷起来了。
lines.en: The water is burning; my scales curl.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在石上。
lines.en: Thrown clear of the water, I slap onto stone.

lines.zh: 水太深太急，我鳃里灌满了沙。
lines.en: The current is too deep; sand fills my gills.

lines.zh: 闷响一过，我在水里翻了身。
lines.en: A dull blast rolls me upside down underwater.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，扎中了我。
lines.en: An arrow cut through the surface and struck me.

lines.zh: 咒光裹住我，鳞片发麻。
lines.en: Spell light wraps me and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 几天没吃东西，我游不动了。
lines.en: Days without food, and I can barely swim.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我沉到最底下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface; I sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我掉进空处。
lines.en: The water is gone; I fall into emptiness.
